texts: Two checks before a 3D model ships: the catalog gate, and a diff that names what broke

Our catalog turns away a character that arrives as more than 8 meshes, and you can run that exact check on your own .glb without uploading it. The write-up covers the five structural checks, how Model Diff names the joints and clips a change removed, the exit codes for CI, and where its rename detection still guesses wrong: three.ws/inspect
